'''B'omarr regeneration gems''' were located in a chamber at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], originally built as a monastery of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]], behind a set of three doors.<ref name="ItWoSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
